text:
Elena P: Heads-up — BlueHarbor Bank wants a migration plan to replace their current LLM provider. Main asks: exact output schema compatibility, predictable sync (sub-100ms) latency for key endpoints, KMS/HSM integration, and a clean pricing comparison for their procurement. POC next Tue.
Sam W: Do they strictly require the same JSON keys? Their clients check for `result.items[*].confidence_score` and `result.trace.id`.
Diego M: We can surface the same keys from our responses — we'll need a small compatibility layer that renames fields and preserves `trace.id`. Also watch for their `confidence_score` range (0-100) vs our float (0-1).
Lena K: For presales collateral, they asked for: 1) a one-page compatibility matrix, 2) sample request/response pairs for three representative calls, 3) rough cost comparison. I can assemble if you drop the data.
security-bot: Redwood: supports cloud KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) + bring-your-own-key for Dedicated/Private. HSM-backed keywrap available in VPC Private deployments via partner. SOC2 Type II & ISO27001 docs shared via SSO. Ensure DPA is signed before POC.
Elena P: Legal will likely require an LOA for on-prem key imports — flagging @legal-bot.
legal-bot: Confirmed. LOA needed for any on-prem key material. We can add SLA addendum for Dedicated. Provide customer legal contact and timing.
Sam W: Important note: their vendor bills per "segment" where a segment ~= 800 bytes; their billing inflates short prompts. We should produce a tokenized comparison table for short/med/long prompts showing billed units and our token count + estimated cost.
Diego M: Proposed shim (quick):
```
# incoming (BlueHarbor)
{ "request": {"text":"...","format":"structured_v2","max_segments":2}, "meta": {"client_trace":"abc123"}}
# shim -> Redwood API
{ "input": "...\n--compat:structured_v2", "mode":"structured", "max_output_chunks":2, "client_meta": {"trace_id":"abc123"}}
# post-process: map response.client_meta.trace_id -> response.result.trace.id; scale confidence: *100
```
Diego M: Expect shim CPU overhead + extra serialization ~40-80ms tail added. Will measure in staging.
Lena K: For SLA ask: they want 99.95% across peak hours and an auditable rollback policy for model rollouts. Can we commit on Dedicated?
security-bot: Dedicated can have 99.95 SLA with contractual terms. Rollback/runbook audit logs are available with Private.
Elena P: Action list for POC start:
- Diego: deliver compatibility mapping + docker shim image + README by EOD Fri.
- Sam/Lena: pricing comparator + tokenized sample prompts (3) + cost delta scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) by Mon morning.
- Security/Legal: confirm LOA + DPA + KMS/HSM steps and a short note on timeline.
- sales-ops: prepare staging org alias and temporary API key for BlueHarbor's integration team.
sales-ops: noted. Will provision an org alias and ephemeral key, please provide allowed IPs list.
Sam W: I'll include three prompts: (1) short lookup ~20 tokens, (2) medium Q&A ~180 tokens, (3) long summarization ~1200 tokens and show competitor segments vs our tokens and estimated $/1000 calls.
Diego M: Also call out edge-case: competitor automatically truncates outputs at `max_segments` and appends `...TRUNCATED` footer. We'll replicate that behavior in the shim to avoid integration surprises.
Lena K: BlueHarbor's security contact also asked about data residency for POC logs — we should state logs are stored in staging region us-east-1 unless they request EU.
security-bot: Affirmed. Can restrict staging logs to eu-west-1 on request; need signed DPA + POC LOA.
Elena P: Nice. One more enterprise blocker: procurement requires an export-control questionnaire about ML model provenance. Can we produce an answer sheet?
legal-bot: We have a template. Diego/Lena please collect model family (open-model vs licensed), quantization level, and provenance statements; legal will finalize.
Diego M: I'll produce sample responses for the three prompts run through the shim and the native Redwood API so they can diff behavior. Expect to have artifacts by Mon afternoon.
Lena K: I'll draft the compatibility matrix and pricing slides; Sam, can you sanity-check numbers before I send to procurement?
Sam W: Yes. I'll review.
Elena P: Thanks team — I'll send BlueHarbor a short POC kickoff note once artifacts are ready. Keep replies here for audit. :rocket:
